description: PAID $0.002 USDC. Coins (~155 Chainlink-priced) whose price moved more than threshold % (default 5) over 1h and/or 24h, biggest first, plus DeFi protocols whose TVL moved more than threshold in 1d. Built for polling. Empty list is a valid answer. Returns JSON coins and, when included, DeFi protocols whose move exceeds the threshold, biggest first. An empty list is a valid answer.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

direction.description: Which direction to keep. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: both. Allowed values: up, down, both.

include_defi.description: Also list DeFi protocols whose TVL moved more than the threshold in 1d. Format: boolean true or false. Example: true. Omit for the server's current choice.

threshold.description: Minimum absolute percent move. Format: a number of percent points. Example: 5. Default: 5, as the existing tool text states.

window.description: Which move window to include. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: 24h. Allowed values: 1h, 24h, both.

name: price_moves
title: Price move alerts ($0.002)
